title: Geometry-aligned dual-branch detection with directional crack-aware attention for EL imaging of photovoltaic cells
venue: Journal of King Saud University - Computer and Information Sciences
mechanism: Directional crack-aware attention: pooling along H and W with 1-D convolutions to boost anisotropic thin structures, plus DCT high-frequency cues injected into the FPN.
adaptation: Insert strip-attention blocks into the two finest U-Net++ decoder stages; add two diagonal strip directions because our cracks are often oblique while busbars and ribbons are axis aligned and would also be amplified.
min_experiment: Arm: house + directional attention. Baseline: house, 5 v 5 seeds. Metrics: test crack IoU, components >= 20 px found. Kill if crack IoU < +0.012 and components found < +0.02.
evidence: R: PVELAD EL2021, mAP50 76.3 v YOLO11 61.5 (+14.8), recall +18.0, single seed 42.
